mentions.name: SNOT-22 sinusitis symptom tracker
mentions.description: A local-only web app for tracking symptoms of chronic sinusitis over time using the Sino-Nasal Outcome Test (SNOT-22) questionnaire. Built with Claude Code, it correlates environmental and medical factors and interventions with rises or falls in symptoms.
mentions.problem: Chronic sinusitis seems tricky for doctors to figure out over time; the app helps correlate environmental and medical factors and interventions with changes in symptoms.
mentions.source_excerpt: I used "Claude Code" to create a local-only webapp for tracking symptoms of my chronic sinusitis, which seems to be tricky for the doctors to figure out, over time, using the "Sino-Nasal Outcome Test" (SNOT-22) questionnaire.  Trying to correlate environmental and medical factors and interventions with raises or decreases in my symptoms.
